objective: Make Word Scripture passage and key-verse references pressable and open the exact existing My Bible chapter/verse without changing Word content, ads, completion, or native runtime.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main SHA 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f is the inspected source baseline on Nov 23, 2026. Independently deployed production OTA fingerprint has not been verified; this is DEV/RC QA only.
chosenApproach: Parse published Word bible_passage and key_verse locally using existing Bible book aliases; use accessible pressable links to /bible/read in my_bible mode, which highlights the requested verse.
selectionRationale: The existing devotional screen renders references as plain text and the Bible reader already supports book/chapter/verse route params. Reusing My Bible avoids network work, new native dependencies, and accidentally invoking the guided Daily Reading mode.
acceptanceChecks: Psalm 42:1–11 opens My Bible Psalm 42 at first verse; Psalm 42:5 opens exact highlighted verse.
Other validated Bible references including numbered books parse correctly; invalid references do not navigate to an incorrect chapter.
Word paraphrase, reflection, offline cache, auth, ads and existing buttons remain intact.
TypeScript, navigation, ads, compact spacing, and source QA must pass before any staging OTA.
No production release or OTA by merging this feature branch.
preserveBehaviors: Devotionals are read account-scoped from their existing authorized online/offline sources.
Existing Bible reader translation, study/commentary, personal notes, narration, verse selection and completed-assignment protections.
Existing AdMob rendering, preload, offscreen lifecycle, navigation responsiveness, bottom tab and safe-area behavior.
Production APK/OTA, staging APK identity and native dependency lock stay unchanged.
alternativeApproaches: Open a browser Bible URL (rejected: adds internet dependency and loses account-selected translation and existing My Bible functionality).
Change Daily Reading guided screen or backend RLS (rejected: unrelated and could incorrectly mark a lesson completed).
Embed full Bible verses in every Word card (rejected: duplicates and risks out-of-date translation content).
releaseTarget: Android staging-user runtime 1.3.2 only after immutable RC and all gates
